name: HHat
description:
Modeled 808-style hi-hat on a phrase pad. Hold to run. X = Euclidean step density, Y = Close → Open continuum (half-open lives in between).
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Euclidean hits per 16-step bar (1–16), then 32nd rolls

params.name: OPEN
params.detail: Close (bottom) → Open (top). Continuous decay / brightness; closing chokes ringing open

params.name: TUNE
params.detail: Transpose the six metal square oscillators

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Master decay scale for the Close–Open range
